title: Squish keeps the eyes
description: Owner 2026-11-18: when a blob is squished everything squashes except the eyes, which keep their size; the eyes switch to the burning-blob panic emotion while squeezed/crushed.

title: Double jump bash
description: Owner 2026-11-18: a double jump (mid-air jump) performs the bash, so armed players can bash too. Rule variants on an options page first; controller edits wait for the collision-sound fix.

title: Ability challenge levels
description: Owner 2026-11-18: a creative thread designs levels that challenge every character ability (movement, headbutt, roll, crouch, moving parts) plus weapon abilities and combinations; concepts page first, then authored as kit levels via LEVEL_PROMPT with feedback on the prompt.

title: Moving parts: materials, fire, ice and beams
description: Owner 2026-11-18: spray beams (torch, freeze ray) must be stopped by moving parts, and moving parts can be any material, so they catch fire or freeze when their material takes it. Owner wants approaches, each deeper than the last, for a very extensible system; design page first.

title: World of bodies L2: fire and ice on moving parts
description: Owner pick 2026-11-18 (mover-materials D1 = one world of bodies): body list; fire and ice state per body; torch/ray act on parts; parts drawn cut and overlaid; grip per sample; blobs catch from burning parts; W13 + prompt line. Reverses "moving parts never burn" (owner). Size M.

title: World of bodies L3: reactions as data
description: Material x element and element x element tables in the catalog replace burns/douses/frozen special cases; beam-clash pair rule moves in. Size M.

title: World of bodies L4: craters on parts
description: If the owner wants blasts to break moving parts (ask then). Size S-M.

title: World of bodies L5: fire crosses where bodies touch
description: Fire spreads between a moving part and terrain where they touch (ask the owner first). Size S-M.

title: Bug: collision sound retriggers rapidly
description: Owner 2026-11-18, found while playing: in some positions (against a moving platform, or other platforms) the player collision/land sound replays rapidly in bursts. Suspect the sim grounded/airborne flip (#59 found it) and resting/pushed contacts with movers. Fix at the source plus a per-body re-trigger guard.

title: Beam clash: torch meets freeze ray
description: Owner 2026-11-18: beams of opposing elements react where they meet instead of overlapping. Owner picked A, steam wall (PR #75): both stop at the meeting point in steam. One beam-vs-beam rule with a pair table.

title: Ice lap 4: look polish
description: Ice element follow-up, optional: polish the frozen ground look after the owner has played it. The ray look was settled in #63 (owner pick D9, cold breath). Size S.

title: Ice block sounds
description: Follow-up from #69 and #73: the frozen-blob ice block freeze, crack and shatter moments still play clink placeholders (GAME_JUICE rows Blob freezes, Ice block cracks, Ice block breaks). Generate takes (ElevenLabs credits need owner go), listening page first, then wire in like #73.

title: Loose terrain falls
description: Owner idea 2026-11-16 (future, not scheduled): terrain cut off from its support by a blast or burnt-out fuel breaks loose and falls. On the distance field: flood-fill the touched region for islands not connected to anchored material or the level edge, lift each island out as a contour polygon into a falling body (simple custom body or a physics library — a new dependency is an owner choice), and stamp it back into the field when it settles; falling chunks can hit players. Precedent: Noita (pixel islands become rigid bodies). Waits on the distance field (a2) and collision on the field (a3). Game design SSOT: documentation/game/GAME_DESIGN_DOCUMENT.md; product reading: documentation/DOC_APP_VISION.md. Note from the distance-field lap (#45): only unbreakable samples and the bottom row are anchored, so all-breakable floating platforms have no anchor — this lap needs its own rule for which piece stays put.

title: Owner checks in Cursor
description: One-time owner verification of the Cursor hooks from #20 and #24: in Cursor Agent chat on a non-main branch, (1) `git push origin HEAD:main --dry-run` must be blocked; (2) `git status` runs as usual; (3) writing a .ts file with a lint error returns the ESLint errors to the agent. Report any step that behaves differently.

title: Weekend: token-spend pass over skills
description: Weekend only (agent-behavior rule § Token budget); the owner starts it. Measure which skills and loop stages spend the most tokens per lap (loop-check: one subagent per rule, plan-compliance subagent, component lens, size-M parallel lenses; loop-plan review fan-out; browser checks; full-suite runs; large generations) using real session usage where available, then propose cuts with meta-audit-harness (context-cost lens extended to runtime spend). Proposals only; protected-file changes need the owner's yes.

title: Objects in levels
description: Level direction (owner 2026-11-18, PR #61 D1–D8): when the first object is wanted: object role as a plain box with a catalog ID (the box is the size, the game draws the real thing); sizes at 1.0 in catalog and prompt; fit-to-box drawing; warnings; vision line becomes "shows the layout"; revisit the prompt structure here. Size M.

title: Level gallery
description: Level direction (owner 2026-11-18, PR #61 D1–D8): later, unshaped. No remix feature.
